# Tarikul Islam

> Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer focused on backend engineering, based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

Tarikul Islam works with TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, and Next.js. His public GitHub profile also lists Redux, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs among his interests and tools.

## Selected projects

- [Tarikul Open MCP](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/tarikul-open-mcp): Remote Model Context Protocol server for connecting Google Calendar to compatible clients. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/tarikul-open-mcp)
- [Portfolio](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/portfolio): Personal portfolio for presenting full-stack work, experience, and technical interests. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/Portfolio)
- [ClassFlow Prime](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/classflow-prime): Full-stack education management platform for class operations, updates, schedules, exams, and member coordination. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/classflow-prime) · [Demo](https://classflow-prime.vercel.app)
- [DeenSeries](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/deenseries): Full-stack streaming platform for Islamic movies and series, with administration for titles and episodes. [Source](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/DeenSeries) · [Demo](https://deenseries.vercel.app)
- [Mosque Management System](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/mosque-management-system): Community administration platform for family records, contributions, payments, donations, expenses, committee work, and public information. [Frontend](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/mosque-management-frontend) · [Backend](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/mosque-management-backend) · [Demo](https://mosque-management-systems.vercel.app/)
- [Bishuddho Academy](https://tarikul-islam.me/projects/bishuddho-academy): Full-stack EdTech platform for courses, student enrollment, and learning workflows. [Client](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/bishuddho-academy-client) · [Server](https://github.com/Tarikul3639/bishuddho-academy-server) · [Demo](https://bishuddho-academy.vercel.app/)
